```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"We should send a strong message to every American child that drugs are wrong and can kill them.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We need to dry up drug demand, hold up drugs at the border, and break up the drug rings that are spreading poison on our streets.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We should open more drug courts to speed justice for drug-related crimes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We should double the number of drug hot-spots where we aggressively target our enforcement efforts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We should expand drug treatment for at-risk youth.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We should make sure that all of our school zones are drug-free zones by stiffening the penalties to those who would use children to peddle drugs and those who would sell drugs anywhere near our schools.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We know that to dry up drug demand, we must provide drug treatment upon demand.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democrats support giving communities relief against gang related crimes to empower communities protect themselves from organized criminal conduct.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We should be tough on drugs no matter which form they take and should not discriminate in sentencing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
